selection_policy: Preselected sources remain selected through acceptance, cancellation and independent history. Postpicked sources stay unselected after the command.
repeated_source_measurement: With one preselected start, the explicit macro selects that same surface again as end; native accepts and produces copies of it.
limits: Readonly local preview and typed direction edits are implemented; native corner click behavior, pixels and option memory remain unverified.
Native matching-option edits can create additional source-shaped copies; local readonly previews do not reproduce those side effects.
Preview caches validate source geometry, attributes/groups, document tolerance and current layer.
Arbitrary general geometry, cross-platform rendering and relative performance remain unverified.
